replay_hash_definition: sha256 of ordered code-cell execution_count + output stream/result text (the deterministic scientific content)
raw_byte_nonreproducibility_reason: nbclient injects wall-clock execution timestamps into cell metadata (iopub.status.busy / iopub.execute_input / shell.execute_reply / iopub.status.idle). These are execution-harness metadata, not scientific content. Byte-identical reproducibility of the raw .ipynb JSON is therefore NOT claimed; the scientific-content reproducibility claim holds (all three replay content hashes equal).
replay_note: Replays are executed IN MEMORY only (no write-back); the embedded notebook is preserved byte-for-byte. Replays differ from the embedded snapshot only in the live final-check count line (embedded 29/29 base vs live 30/30 after the additive post-notebook closure check).
